### ApprovalFlows {#type-commerz-b2b-approvals-contracts-approvalflows}

`Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Contracts\ApprovalFlows`

Evaluates B2B budget threshold rules & associate spending limits and drives multi-step ApprovalFlow lifecycles.

```php
interface ApprovalFlows {
    // Records an approver's approval decision and marks the flow `Approved` once `requiredApprovals` is reached.
    approve(\Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApproveFlow $command): \Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApprovalFlowView;
    createRule(\Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\CreateApprovalRule $command): \Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApprovalRuleView;
    // Evaluates whether `$command->buyer` requires approval to place `$command->amount` under `$command->businessUnitId`.
    evaluate(\Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\EvaluateApproval $command): \Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApprovalEvaluation;
    find(\Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApprovalFlowId $id): ?\Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApprovalFlowView;
    findLatestForSubject(string $subjectRef): ?\Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApprovalFlowView;
    get(\Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApprovalFlowId $id): \Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApprovalFlowView;
    // Opens an `ApprovalFlow` (`Pending` when approval is required, or immediately `Approved` when under all thresholds).
    initiate(\Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\InitiateApprovalFlow $command): \Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApprovalFlowView;
    // Rejects a pending approval flow.
    reject(\Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\RejectFlow $command): \Commerz\B2b\Approvals\Data\ApprovalFlowView;
    // Active approval rules applying to `$businessUnitId` (including inherited ancestor rules with `appliesToDescendants = true` when `$includeInherited` is true).
    rulesFor(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitId $businessUnitId, bool $includeInherited = true): array;
}
```

### BusinessUnits {#type-commerz-b2b-businessunits-contracts-businessunits}

`Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Contracts\BusinessUnits`

Manages B2B BusinessUnit hierarchies (root companies, divisions, departments) and Associate role/spending policies.

```php
interface BusinessUnits {
    // Ancestor business units ordered from root down to immediate parent (excluding `$id`).
    ancestors(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitId $id): array;
    assignAssociate(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\AssignAssociate $command): \Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\AssociateView;
    // Lists associates on `$id` (and inherited associates from ancestors when `$includeInherited` is true, with local assignments taking precedence over inherited ones).
    associates(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitId $id, bool $includeInherited = true): array;
    // Direct child business units of `$parentId`.
    children(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitId $parentId): array;
    create(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\CreateBusinessUnit $command): \Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitView;
    // All descendants under `$id` ordered by materialized path.
    descendants(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitId $id): array;
    find(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitId $id): ?\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitView;
    findByCode(string $code): ?\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitView;
    get(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitId $id): \Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitView;
    removeAssociate(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\RemoveAssociate $command): void;
    // Resolves an associate's effective membership on `$id`, walking up the ancestor chain from nearest parent to root when `$includeInherited` is true.
    resolveAssociate(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitId $id, \Commerz\Identity\CustomerRef $customer, bool $includeInherited = true): ?\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\AssociateView;
    update(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\UpdateBusinessUnit $command): \Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitView;
}
```

### CreditAccounts {#type-commerz-b2b-paymentterms-contracts-creditaccounts}

`Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Contracts\CreditAccounts`

Manages B2B credit accounts and atomic credit holds across the BusinessUnit hierarchy (`INV-B2B-CREDIT-001`).

```php
interface CreditAccounts {
    // Captures a reserved credit hold into `usedCredit` (e.g. when invoiced).
    capture(\Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Data\CaptureCredit $command): \Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Data\CreditAccountView;
    configure(\Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Data\ConfigureCreditAccount $command): \Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Data\CreditAccountView;
    // Resolves the credit account for `$businessUnitId` in `$currency`, walking up ancestors when `$inheritFromAncestors` is true so divisions can draw from a parent corporate credit pool.
    findForBusinessUnit(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitId $businessUnitId, \Commerz\Money\Currency $currency, bool $inheritFromAncestors = true): ?\Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Data\CreditAccountView;
    // Releases an uncaptured credit hold back to available credit (e.g. on cancellation).
    release(\Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Data\ReleaseCredit $command): \Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Data\CreditAccountView;
    // Records a repayment against `usedCredit` when an invoice is settled.
    repay(\Commerz\B2b\BusinessUnits\Data\BusinessUnitId $businessUnitId, \Commerz\Money\Money $amount): \Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Data\CreditAccountView;
    // Atomically reserves deferred credit exposure for an order or quote conversion.
    reserve(\Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Data\ReserveCredit $command): \Commerz\B2b\PaymentTerms\Data\CreditHoldView;
}
```

### B2bQuotes {#type-commerz-b2b-quotes-contracts-b2bquotes}

`Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Contracts\B2bQuotes`

3-stage B2B Quotes workflow (`QuoteRequest -> StagedQuote -> NegotiatedQuote`) with `validUntil`, `requestRenegotiation`, approval & credit checks, and locked-price conversion to an `Order`.

```php
interface B2bQuotes {
    // Converts a `NegotiatedQuote` into an `Order` at its locked unit prices, enforcing `validUntil`, `ApprovalFlow` budget thresholds & spending limits, `PaymentTerms` non-recurring plan rules, and atomic credit reservation.
    convertToOrder(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\ConvertQuoteToOrder $command): \Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\ConvertedQuoteOrderView;
    findNegotiated(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\NegotiatedQuoteId $id): ?\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\NegotiatedQuoteView;
    findRequest(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\QuoteRequestId $id): ?\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\QuoteRequestView;
    findStaged(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\StagedQuoteId $id): ?\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\StagedQuoteView;
    getNegotiated(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\NegotiatedQuoteId $id): \Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\NegotiatedQuoteView;
    getRequest(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\QuoteRequestId $id): \Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\QuoteRequestView;
    getStaged(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\StagedQuoteId $id): \Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\StagedQuoteView;
    // Stage 3: Publishes a `StagedQuote` into a locked `NegotiatedQuote` offer sent to the buyer.
    publish(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\PublishNegotiatedQuote $command): \Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\NegotiatedQuoteView;
    // Buyer requests renegotiation on a `Sent` `NegotiatedQuote`, transitioning it to `RenegotiationRequested` and reopening a new draft `StagedQuote` revision for the seller.
    requestRenegotiation(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\RequestRenegotiation $command): \Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\RenegotiationResult;
    // Stage 2: Seller opens a `StagedQuote` workspace for a `QuoteRequest`, applying custom line unit prices, payment terms, and `validUntil`.
    stage(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\StageQuote $command): \Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\StagedQuoteView;
    // Stage 1: Buyer submits a `QuoteRequest` (from a cart or explicit lines).
    submitRequest(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\SubmitQuoteRequest $command): \Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\QuoteRequestView;
    // Updates a draft `StagedQuote` (e.g. during initial staging or renegotiation).
    updateStaged(\Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\UpdateStagedQuote $command): \Commerz\B2b\Quotes\Data\StagedQuoteView;
}
```
